name: Paywall
summary: Wrap a pro-gated affordance, or set the crown beside a control that keeps its own button; the shared upsell renders itself — the crown upgrade mark, title, one-sentence body, the unlock line, and the Upgrade CTA are baked in; See all plans is opt-in with `show-plans`.
highlights: Wraps a pro-gated affordance, or sits beside its own button
Shared upsell renders itself: crown mark, title, one-sentence body
Fixed unlock line and Upgrade button baked in; See all plans is opt-in (show-plans)
lead: EVERY pro-gated affordance routes through one element so both products feel like one. You give <aha-paywall> the feature, the copy and the plan; it renders the compliant popover — the Vivid Pink crown upgrade mark (never a generic crown glyph), the title, the one-sentence benefit, the "Unlock with the <Plan> plan." line (English default; a translated product passes `unlock-label`), and a shared <aha-button> Upgrade CTA (positive/green); add `show-plans` for a secondary See all plans button beside it (off by default). Analytics comes back as events. A hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip is the drift this replaces.

spec.label: Upgrade mark
spec.value: 16×16 Vivid Pink circle (--aha-color-primary) + white crown — a focusable control with Default/Hover/Active states; the custom mark, not a Phosphor crown

spec.label: Popover
spec.value: dark grey surface #303030 (--aha-bg-dark-raised, grey-95: one step above black #1A1A1A), 300px outer width, padding included (opt-in `width`, never past 82vw), so 268px of content, 16px padding, radius 12; animates opacity + lift on open via the motion tokens

spec.label: Anatomy
spec.value: header (crown + title) · body (one sentence + "Unlock with the <Plan> plan.") · footer (Upgrade; + See all plans when show-plans is set)

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: top (default) or bottom, 8px from the anchor; opt-in left or right hangs the popover 8px beside the anchor, vertically centred on it, with the arrow on the facing edge; fitPaywall falls back to beside the anchor, then to scrolling inside, when neither above nor below has the room

spec.label: Rich body
spec.value: opt-in slot="body" replaces the plain-text body when the one sentence needs a link or emphasis; the title, the unlock line and both CTAs stay baked in, and a link slotted directly (<a slot="body">) takes the white body text, underlined; a link nested inside another slotted element keeps the page's own link style

spec.label: Buttons
spec.value: Shared <aha-button>s — Upgrade (variant=positive, Vivid Pink) alone by default, plus See all plans with `show-plans` (variant=secondary, re-themed for the dark surface through the --aha-button-default-* inputs: white label in every state, --aha-gray-70 #8A8A8A border that turns white on hover and press, white focus ring; the row wraps when translated labels do not fit); never hand-rolled

spec.label: Analytics
spec.value: paywall-shown on open · paywall-upgrade before Upgrade nav · paywall-plans before See-all-plans nav (only with show-plans) — all { feature, plan }

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: Upgrade opens ahaslides.com/pricing (new tab, noopener); See all plans (only with show-plans) opens plans-url; preventDefault either event to run your own flow. Esc / click-away close

props.name: feature-key
props.desc: Stable token (e.g. custom_survey_url) — drives analytics + DOM hooks. Required.

props.name: feature-label
props.desc: Short noun-phrase title next to the crown (used as the popover title unless title is set)

props.name: title
props.desc: Popover title override; falls back to feature-label. May wrap to two lines

props.name: body
props.desc: Exactly one sentence describing the benefit of unlocking; ends with a period

props.name: description
props.desc: Popover description override; falls back to body

props.name: required-plan
props.desc: Drives the unlock line and the analytics plan prop

props.name: placement
props.desc: Popover side relative to the anchor. left/right sit the popover 8px beside the anchor, vertically centred on it; `align` applies to top/bottom only. fitPaywall picks top or bottom; in a viewport too short for either it sits beside the anchor, kept 8px inside the viewport with the arrow still on the anchor, and with no room beside the anchor it scrolls inside the taller side, arrow hidden, with every button reachable by Tab

props.name: width
props.type: CSS length (a bare number is px)
props.desc: Popover outer width, padding included, for longer copy or a rich body; never past 82vw. The --aha-paywall-width custom property on the host does the same

props.name: align
props.desc: Which popover edge sits on the anchor: center (default) centres it, start puts its left edge on the anchor's left with the arrow under the anchor, end mirrors that on the right. Use start/end for an anchor near a panel edge; `fitPaywall(el)` (exported) picks align and placement from the room around the anchor and slides the popover back inside the viewport through `--aha-paywall-shift`. <aha-setting-row> and <aha-settings-item> call it before the popover opens

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How the popover opens; click-away + Escape close a click popover; Escape closes the popover first, before any host handler, and returns focus to the opener

props.name: cta-label
props.desc: The positive CTA verb; override only with a clear reason

props.name: show-plans
props.desc: Shows the secondary See all plans button beside Upgrade. Absent, the footer is Upgrade alone and the button is hidden (out of the tab order and the accessibility tree). plans-label and plans-url apply only when it is set

props.name: plans-label
props.desc: The secondary CTA label — routes to the full pricing page; applies only with show-plans

props.name: unlock-label
props.desc: The whole unlock line, for a translated product. `{plan}` is replaced by the plan name in bold (e.g. "Mở khoá với gói {plan}."); with no `{plan}` the line is plain text. Set as text, never HTML

props.name: plan-label
props.desc: The plan name shown (bold) in the unlock line; pass a translated name. Drives display only, required-plan still sets the analytics plan

props.name: mark-label
props.desc: The accessible name of the crown upgrade mark, for a translated product. Applies only when the mark is the anchor (no slotted affordance); set as text, and a later change applies in place

props.name: upgrade-url
props.desc: Where Upgrade navigates (new tab, noopener)

props.name: plans-url
props.desc: Where See all plans navigates (new tab, noopener); applies only with show-plans

props.name: slot (default)
props.desc: The gated affordance = the anchor; omit it to use the crown upgrade mark as the anchor

props.name: slot="body"
props.desc: Rich body content that replaces the body/description text: the one benefit sentence with a link or emphasis, still never a multi-paragraph body; slot a link directly (<a slot="body">) so it takes the white body text; the unlock line and CTAs stay fixed. A body-slot child alone keeps the crown mark as the anchor

props.name: togglePopover({ source })
props.desc: Opens or closes the popover from code. `source` (optional) is the element that opened it, the one close() and Escape return focus to; it is read only when opening. toggleLockedPaywall calls this for you, so use it directly only when no click event exists

props.name: toggleLockedPaywall(paywall, event)
props.desc: Opens or closes the popover from a click on any control outside it: an enabled button beside its crown, a locked row, or the wrapper of a disabled control. Call it in that control's click listener; it stops the native click (a parent React onClick still fires, so call event.stopPropagation() there too), fits the popover to the room around the crown, and records the focusable control on the click's path, up to the listener, as the opener

props.name: close()
props.desc: For a host closing the popover from code. Closes it and returns focus to the element that opened it (the anchor when that element is gone or refuses focus); no-op when closed; leaves focus alone when no opener was recorded and focus is not inside the popover. Click-away and the CTAs close without moving focus

props.name: paywall-shown / paywall-upgrade / paywall-plans
props.desc: Analytics contract; paywall-upgrade + paywall-plans are cancelable (preventDefault to run your own flow)

whenToUse.when: any feature locked behind a paid plan — editor affordance, share option, results feature, dashboard action
the feature has no natural clickable anchor (e.g. a field label) — omit the slot and the crown is the anchor

the control keeps its own place and look (a locked setting, a card's button) and cannot be wrapped: set the crown mark beside it and call toggleLockedPaywall from the control's click, so both open the one popover
the default gate; use essential only for essential-tier features
a hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip drifts from the presenter app — always this element

opinion.note: Feature label is a short noun phrase; body is exactly one sentence about the benefit (not "This is a Pro feature"); the unlock line keeps its English format; a translated product passes `unlock-label` with `{plan}` instead of rewording it in place, and `mark-label` for the crown mark's accessible name. Popover/placement mechanics defer to aha-design-overlays; a single plan-gated setting row lives in the Settings surface.

codeNote: One zero-dep custom element renders the shared upsell; the paywall skill's rules (crown-not-Phosphor upgrade mark, one-sentence body, fixed unlock line, Upgrade CTA and the opt-in See all plans CTA — both the shared <aha-button>, the analytics events, dark grey 300/16/12 surface) are baked into its shadow DOM — a consumer can't hand-roll a drifting prompt. The popover animates opacity+lift on a persistent node via the motion tokens; the anchor carries aria-expanded and Escape closes it first, before any host handler, and returns focus to the element that opened it. The judge/eval + copy voice stay in the aha-design skill.

selfCheck.label: Upgrade (positive) + optional See all plans via show-plans (secondary) — both shared <aha-button> (PAYWALL-04)
requiredPlan essential|pro drives unlock line + analytics (PAYWALL-07)
placement left/right centres the popover beside the anchor; top/bottom unchanged
width opt-in, outer width with padding included; 300px default kept
slot="body" replaces the text body only; unlock line + CTAs stay baked in

conformance.$about: Measured against the RENDERED shadow-DOM UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The [data-probe] paywall is shown OPEN so the popover — dark surface, radius, crown mark, and the two shared <aha-button> CTAs — is measurable. The Upgrade button's Vivid Pink is read from inside aha-button's own shadow root (the primitive it reuses).
conformance.measure: (function(){var s=document.querySelector('aha-paywall[data-probe]').shadowRoot; var g=function(sel,p){var el=s.querySelector(sel); return el?getComputedStyle(el)[p]:null;}; var btnBg=function(sel){var b=s.querySelector(sel); var inner=b&&b.shadowRoot&&b.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); return inner?getComputedStyle(inner).backgroundColor:null;}; return { popoverBg:g('.pop','backgroundColor'), popoverRadius:g('.pop','borderTopLeftRadius'), popoverWidth:g('.pop','width'), popoverOuterWidth:s.querySelector('.pop').offsetWidth, titleLineHeight:g('.plabel','lineHeight'), plansBorder:getComputedStyle(s.querySelector('.plans').shadowRoot.querySelector('button')).borderTopColor, upgradeBg:btnBg('.upgrade'), markBg:g('.phead .mark','backgroundColor'), crownPresent:!!s.querySelector('.phead .mark aha-icon[name="system-crown-badge-fill"]'), plansPresent:!!(s.querySelector('.plans')&&!s.querySelector('.plans').hidden&&s.querySelector('.plans').textContent.trim()==='See all plans'), planLabel:(s.querySelector('.punlock b')||{}).textContent };})()
